extracted_factors.Label: Infrastructure Expansion
extracted_factors.Description: Expansion of roads, airports, ports, and other infrastructure projects directly leads to deforestation in Indonesia.

extracted_factors.Label: Economic Incentives
extracted_factors.Description: Economic growth targets and development policies prioritize infrastructure development, leading to deforestation.

extracted_factors.Label: Governance Challenges
extracted_factors.Description: Weak governance, corruption, and lack of clear land tenure systems contribute to deforestation risks from infrastructure expansion.

extracted_factors.Label: Global Trade Demands
extracted_factors.Description: Demand for export commodities influences infrastructure projects that facilitate deforestation.

extracted_factors.Label: Sustainable Practices in Private Sector
extracted_factors.Description: Efforts by private companies to adopt eco-friendly practices and technologies to mitigate infrastructure impact.

extracted_factors.Label: Community Engagement
extracted_factors.Description: Involvement of local communities in the planning and monitoring of sustainable infrastructure projects.
